title: Fix a comment typo in an anchored script
notes: Choice: no alert. The only changed lines are comments, so the file counts at half strength (COSMETIC_FACTOR 0.5): 1.0 x (0.5 + 0.5 x 0.24) x 0.5 = 0.31, below Balanced (0.5) and Strict (0.4). If the edited comment had removed an identifier the page quotes, the 0.3 identifier boost would lift it over the threshold.

pages.title: Payments rollback runbook
pages.storage:
Use this when a payments-api release misbehaves. Script: scripts/rollback.sh.

Steps

  1. Check the release history with helm history payments.

  2. If the default of 300 seconds is too short, raise ROLLBACK_TIMEOUT. Its default lives in deploy/helm/values.yaml.

  3. Run the rollback:

bash

Under the hood the script runs:

bash

Owner: Platform team. Escalate in #payments-oncall.
